# Bosnia & Herzegovina World Cup 2026 Odds, Predictions & Best Bets
[...]
The 2026 FIFA World Cup arrives with Bosnia and Herzegovina priced as outsiders in the outright winner market, sitting 27th out of 48 competing nations at odds of 500/1 with the best available price sitting as short as 250/1 at certain points in the market.
[...]
This article covers Bosnia and Herzegovina World Cup 2026 odds across all major markets, a full squad and tactical breakdown, their route through the group stage, and the best bets available for supporters looking to back the Dragons.
[...]
- Best Pick: Bosnia and Herzegovina to Win Group B
- Confidence: 2/5
- Best Odds: 7/1
- Reason: A tough group featuring Canada and Switzerland makes topping Group B unlikely, but the price reflects a team with genuine knockout mentality and a solid qualifying record.
[...]
Should they survive the group, a Round of 32 fixture against a likely second-place finisher from an adjacent group awaits. Reaching the Round of 16 would already represent an improvement on their only previous World Cup appearance. The Bosnia and Herzegovina World Cup odds to win the tournament at 500/1 are more a reflection of genuine probability than a mispriced market: the value for most bettors lies in stage-of-elimination markets rather than the outright.
[...]
- Outright Winner (500/1): Long-odds territory. Only for those looking for speculative value given Bosnia and Herzegovina’s market position of 27th out of 48 teams.
[...]
- To Win Group B (7/1): The best available group-winner price. Competitive given Canada and Switzerland are both well-fancied, but offers value if Switzerland under-perform.
[...]
Bosnia and Herzegovina face a difficult group, but 7/1 to top Group B reflects a genuine mathematical possibility. Switzerland are the most technically accomplished side in the group, yet Bosnia and Herzegovina’s recent form in competitive knockout football, including penalty shootout wins over Wales and Italy, shows they perform when the pressure is highest.
[...]
A strong qualifying record of 5 wins, 4 draws and 1 loss across 10 games, scoring 19 and conceding 9, points to a team capable of grinding out results. The 7/1 price is only worth considering if you believe Switzerland will struggle to hit top form early in the tournament.
[...]
With Qatar as the third group opponent and a winnable final match day, advancing past the group stage is the most realistic short-term target for Bosnia and Herzegovina World Cup 2026 bettors.

highlights:

[...]

Bosnia and Herzegovina are participating in their second finals after qualifying for the FIFA World Cup 2026. Sergej Barbarez’s side, led by captain Edin Džeko, face Canada, Switzerland and Qatar in Group B. Below you will find everything you need to know about Bosnia and Herzegovina at the 2026 World Cup: their fixtures, squad, qualifying record, key players, coach and tournament history.
[...]
## Bosnia and Herzegovina's World Cup matches
[...]
12 June: Canada vs Bosnia and Herzegovina (Toronto, 21:00 CET)18 June: Switzerland vs Bosnia and Herzegovina (Los Angeles, 21:00 CET)24 June: Bosnia and Herzegovina vs Qatar (Seattle, 21:00 CET)
[...]
Bosnia and Herzegovina’s group fixtures are being played across three host cities, with the knockout rounds to follow for teams that progress from Group B.
[...]
A team with a healthy mix of young stars and strong veterans, Bosnia and Herzegovina can call upon the likes of the promising Kerim Alajbegović and Esmir Bajraktarević in their 26-man World Cup squad, while the 40-year-old Edin Džeko remains their go-to man for goals.

[...]
A forward who started his career in the youth ranks at Velež in his native Mostar, Sergej Barbarez has been coach of Bosnia and Herzegovina since April 2024. His peak playing years were in Germany, representing Hannover, Union Berlin, Hansa Rostock, Borussia Dortmund, Hamburg and Leverkusen. He scored 17 goals in 47 games for the national team.
[...]
Now 40, the 'Bosnian Diamond' is his national team's top scorer (73) and most-capped player (148). He started his career at Željezničar in his native Sarajevo, and won league titles in Germany (Wolfsburg 2008/09) and England (Man City 2011/12 and 2013/14). UEFA Europa League joint-top scorer with Roma in 2016/17, he played in the 2022/23 UEFA Champions League final with Inter and is the oldest player to score in the Conference League.
[...]
Most appearances: Asmir Begović, Muhamed Bešić, Edin Džeko, Vedad Ibišević, Miralem Pjanić, Emir Spahić (3)Top scorer: Edin Džeko, Vedad Ibišević, Miralem Pjanić, Avdija Vršajević (1)Best performance: Group stage (2014)World Cup 2022: Did not qualify
[...]
Part of Yugoslavia until the early 1990s, Bosnia and Herzegovina have yet to qualify for a UEFA European Championship, but this is their second World Cup. In their first, they lost to Argentina and Nigeria in their opening games, and ended up third in the Group F rankings following a 3-1 last-day victory against Iran.
